title: MAUL Mall Explorer
description: Pokémon-style 8-bit exploration of the MAUL home malls (Galleria Overlook and Cogskill Arcade): living NPCs, hidden things to notice or search for, secret areas, overheard chatter, knowledge-aware dialogue with codex links, per-character discovery logs, music and 8-bit sound, a weekly season clock, and visiting pop-up booths.
